verdict.rationale: ByteAsk publishes a working llms.txt at byteask.ai/llms.txt and a second, more detailed one at docs.byteask.ai/llms.txt that indexes all CLI documentation pages (overview, features, headless/CI, slash commands, changelog), both verified live via runtime probes returning actual agent-readable content. This directly supports an AI-native user or agent pointing at llms.txt to ingest ByteAsk's documentation. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration that agents successfully consume these files, and markdown-formatted doc pages (the docs-md probe for overview.md returned 404, relying on the SPA/llms.txt route instead).
